summary: Precision Drilling Corp filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing that board member Alice Wong stepped down immediately on July 13, 2026. She served since 2024, and was on the Audit, HR/Comp, and HSE committees. The chairman thanked her for service. No reasons given beyond her own advice. There is no forced departure or abrupt change, so this is a routine voluntary board resignation. This is a routine current report of a voluntary board change, not a forced/abrupt departure, so it does not qualify as a special situation; however, per instructions only forced/abrupt departures qualify for "Management Changes," so this filing is not a special situation.
